info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Hotel Loyalty Points Earn-v2-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the earning of loyalty points for hotel bookings, enhancing customer engagement and retention. It allows hotels to programmatically award points to customers based on their stays or actions, thereby incentivizing repeat business. Typical consumers of this API include hotel management systems and loyalty program platforms, which can integrate this functionality to reward guests seamlessly. The API is designed to streamline the point allocation process, ensuring that customers can easily earn and track their loyalty rewards.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to earn points by completing specific actions within the application. The points earned can be redeemed for rewards or benefits. Ensure to check the eligibility criteria for earning points before making a request.
